status_note: Reproduces on 55.0.0, the latest release (`not implemented`). `cardinality` of an empty list is fixed by 55.0.0 (`0`). No upstream issue found. Main not checked.
title: The Substrait consumer has no `ListElement` reference
summary: The Substrait consumer refuses a `ListElement` direct reference (`Direct reference with types other than StructField is not supported`), so a plan cannot index a list; and on 51.0.0 `cardinality([])` is NULL, where the reference (and 55.0.0) give 0.
repro: The Substrait plan (Lean's `--write`) of `select [k, x][2] from a` fails: `This feature is not implemented: Direct reference with types other than StructField is not supported` (51.0.0 and 55.0.0).
handling: None: sverify no longer runs DataFusion. The entry records the bug.
